title: Nutty Smoky Moroccan Lamb Tagine
description: A comforting Moroccan dish featuring lamb, carnaroli rice, and a blend of aromatic spices, with a nutty and smoky flavor profile, and a grassy, glassy-jelly texture from the addition of apricot jam and pomegranate molasses.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the smoked paprika, ground cumin, and ground coriander, and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the carnaroli rice, apricot jam, pomegranate molasses, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add 2 cups of water to the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the pot, and simmer for 1 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender and the rice is cooked.
Stir in the chopped almonds and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with additional chopped almonds if desired.
